description:
List this project's active and pending steering rules.

    Steering rules are prepended to every planning, development and QA prompt.
    Each rule has `state` (`active` = in the prompt, `pending` = waiting for a
    project member's approval, `expired` = past its expiry and no longer in the
    prompt) and `origin`: `owner_request` (written from a
    Request), `retro_kaizen` (a sprint retrospective kaizen),
    `failure_pattern` (a recurring failure), `automatic` (activated without
    human review from another source) or `unknown` (a legacy rule with no
    recorded source). `auto_approved` is true when no person reviewed it.
    Retired rules are not listed. Use approve_steering_rule and
    retire_steering_rule with a rule's `id`.
name: list_steering_rules
title: List Steering Rules
